question: What status of the Gāyatrī among mantras is about to be declared?
premises: A teaching is about to be given
Gāyatrī is called mother of the Vedas
inference: The speaker will tell of the Gāyatrī as the mother of the Vedas among mantras
plain_english: I shall tell of the Gāyatrī, the mother of the Vedas, among mantras.
